test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a tributary of river Indus?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shyok**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Shyok** is a tributary of the river Indus.
 
• The Shyok River originates from the Rimo Glacier, one of the tongues of Siachen Glacier.
 
• It flows through the Ladakh region in India and the Gilgit-Baltistan region of Pakistan before merging with the Indus River.<
